prompt: Mateo runs (fast) than the other defenders in our football club.
explanation_ru: Наречие fast короткое и совпадает по форме с прилагательным, поэтому в сравнении с than оно образует форму faster.

prompt: My green backpack holds (few) clothes than the blue suitcase.
explanation_ru: Существительное clothes употребляется во множественном числе, поэтому для значения «меньше» используется fewer, а не less.

prompt: Which towel in the bathroom dries (fast) after a shower?
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о выборе одного полотенца из нескольких, поэтому нужна превосходная степень короткого наречия fast — (the) fastest.

prompt: Kamil played the puzzle game ___ than anyone else at our club.
explanation_ru: Наречие well образует сравнительную степень не по правилу — better. Типичная ошибка — говорить more good или more well.

prompt: This bright desk lamp uses fewer electricity than my old one.
answer: This bright desk lamp uses less electricity than my old one.
accepted_answers: This bright desk lamp uses less electricity than my old one.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным electricity нужно использовать less, а не fewer. Типичная ошибка — путать fewer и less.

prompt: The side hall doesn't seat quite (many / people) the main room.
explanation_ru: После отрицания с quite для сравнения количества исчисляемых существительных используется конструкция as many + существительное + as.

prompt: Our office building has three lifts, and nobody likes the old service lift. It moves (slowly) than the passenger lifts, and it also has (little) space inside. Last week, Priya took the stairs instead and still reached the fifth floor (early) than I did.
explanation_ru: Наречие на -ly образует сравнение через more (more slowly), с неисчисляемым space требуется less, а короткое наречие early меняется на earlier.

prompt: Testing five showroom chairs helped, because I liked the padded one (well) and worked (long) in it.
explanation_ru: Из пяти кресел выбирается одно, поэтому нужны превосходные степени наречий: irregular well даёт (the) best, а короткое long — (the) longest.

prompt: Local cyclists prefer the narrow river lane because ___ cars pass along it than down the main road.
explanation_ru: Перед исчисляемым существительным cars во множественном числе в сравнении с than ставится fewer. Типичная ошибка — использовать less с исчисляемыми словами.

prompt: Our old plastic trays create more rubbish than these paper boxes. → These paper boxes don't create …
answer: These paper boxes don't create as much rubbish as our old plastic trays.
accepted_answers: These paper boxes don't create as much rubbish as our old plastic trays.
These paper boxes do not create as much rubbish as our old plastic trays.
These paper boxes don't create so much rubbish as our old plastic trays.
These paper boxes do not create so much rubbish as our old plastic trays.
These paper boxes don't create as much rubbish as our old plastic trays do.
These paper boxes do not create as much rubbish as our old plastic trays do.
explanation_ru: Чтобы сохранить смысл с отрицанием, сравнение more rubbish than перестраивается в not as much rubbish as, так как rubbish — неисчисляемое существительное.

prompt: Rain turned the forest track into thick mud shortly before sunset. We didn't have nearly (much / daylight) we needed to reach the village safely. Everyone pedalled (hard) up the last hill, though I had to steer (carefully) on the slippery bends.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым daylight после not nearly нужно as much daylight as; короткое наречие hard даёт harder, а наречие на -ly carefully — more carefully.

prompt: "In your view, which of the five teams explained their plan (clearly) to the judges?"
explanation_ru: Сравниваются пять команд, поэтому нужна превосходная степень наречия на -ly: (the) most clearly.

prompt: You bought the new edition of a history book. Its author explains events clearly, unlike the older edition, and it includes almost no maps compared with the old one.
options: The new edition explains events more clearly than the old one, though it has fewer maps.
The new edition explains events more clearly than the old one, though it has less maps.
The old edition explains events more clearly than the new one, though it has fewer maps.
The new edition explains events as clearly as the old one, and it has as many maps.
explanation_ru: Ситуации точно соответствует первый вариант: наречие more clearly передаёт более понятное объяснение, а с исчисляемым maps правильно стоит fewer.

prompt: Dear team, we reviewed five office software plans before making a final decision. Among all five options, the third plan costs (little) money at the start. Our small budget goes (far) with this choice than with our old programme, and we expect (few) delays than last year.
explanation_ru: Среди пяти вариантов используется превосходная форма the least с неисчисляемым money, далее в сравнении с than стоят irregular further от far и fewer перед исчисляемым delays.

prompt: Regional sales performed (badly) than our revised report had predicted, although the support staff handled complaints (calmly) than in spring.
explanation_ru: Наречие badly имеет особую сравнительную форму worse, а наречие на -ly calmly образует сравнительную степень с помощью more — more calmly.

prompt: As the loaded van climbed the steep mountain pass in the rain, its engine had to work ___ than Tariq had expected.
explanation_ru: Наречие hard образует сравнительную степень суффиксом -er (harder). Типичные ошибки — говорить more hard или придумывать форму hardlier.

prompt: While the second theory sounded believable at first, our research group found less reliable facts to support it than we had hoped.
answer: While the second theory sounded believable at first, our research group found fewer reliable facts to support it than we had hoped.
accepted_answers: While the second theory sounded believable at first, our research group found fewer reliable facts to support it than we had hoped.
explanation_ru: Существительное facts исчисляемое и стоит во множественном числе, поэтому вместо less нужно fewer. Типичная ошибка — ставить less перед любым словом.

prompt: Hospital staff tested the new backup power unit outside the clinic yesterday. The new machine runs (quietly) than the old model, so patients inside can rest in peace. It also starts (well) in freezing weather and does not burn nearly (much / fuel) the previous one.
explanation_ru: С глаголами runs и starts нужны наречия more quietly и better, а после does not ... nearly с неисчисляемым fuel требуется конструкция as much fuel as.
